=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' (this page): Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 05)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy built 15 December 2009), page 2, slip 2•05. Once per game, may place this Effect out of play to reduce your battle damage by 4. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! (V){{!}}NOOOOOOOOOOOO!. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-05-Broken_Concentration.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “2 • 05” bottom right, the Virtual Block 6 set mark.
* '''Source publication''' ([[Broken Concentration (V)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 6 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1262_5">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013].
